note: Measurement tool costs (docs/168 §9, Measurement cost rule PLAN.md 2026-10-24). Keys are the names tools/harness/hitch-ab.ts toolsOn() prints. msPerS = sim-thread ms per second the tool costs (null = not measured). timing: yes = allowed in timing runs with its cost taken off, after = light, allowed once its tool-cost.json job has a result, no = correctness runs only. bundles: costs measured for several tools together; taken off when all members are on.

prof-lean.how: stutter-profile.js stages:false: iteration boundary, catch-up step and publish hooks; the measurement base, on in every arm

prof-tasks.how: per-task attribution ~300 ns per task run on the dummy, ~2-3 ms/s inferred (docs/166 §3)

frames.how: frame-times.js Frida session, one record per rendered frame (main thread)

mainstack.how: suspends the main thread per sample, never the sim thread

samplers.how: managed + native stack samplers suspend the sim thread per sample

taskstall.how: probe /taskstall watch suspends the sim thread

inroom.how: lot tree dumps inside sim-thread hooks (docs/111)

livereads2.how: grid dumps and point calls on the sim thread (docs/114)

f4b.how: Frida reads per path copy + a terrain call on the sim thread (docs/99 §12.6)

story.how: story fuzzer drives 8-12 Sims: a workload, not a passive tool (docs/171)

HitchAttr.how: no hook: per sim frame wait sums the profiler reads (docs/96 §9)

HitchAttr.Holders.how: per lock acquire/release pair on every thread while on

RouteJobPhases.how: two QPC reads per timed call on the route worker; other threads one compare (docs/150 §7)

RouteJobPhases.SyncPlans.how: the same timers on sim-thread sync plans

RouteJobPhases.HostSplit.how: host-call timers per worker host call (docs/159)

RouteJobPhases.GoalStepSplit.how: goal-step sub-phase timers, needs GoalSplit (docs/178 T3)

LogFallbackMs<200.how: one log line per sync plan above the threshold (release 200 ms)

LogFallbackStack.how: script stack walk (N frames) per logged sync plan

OwnJobWait.how: counts sim waits behind own route jobs, line per wait >= 300 ms (docs/178 T4)

UnseenProbe.how: per locomotion agent per tick: visible/unseen class + split counters (docs/143)

RouteEarlyOut.observe.how: per world A* a no-path proof check (components, flood colours, memo); the search still runs (docs/142)

PlanRepeat.how: per Route_PlanLocked a key hash + 4096-plan ring (docs/23 §18)

CellMemoProbe.how: per in-room leg a key hash (needs RouteJobPhases); probe jobs only, no cost job yet

ProbeP1b.how: pass-through stubs at gate callers + QL writer stubs (docs/84); probe jobs only, no cost job yet

ProbeP10.how: pass-through stubs on route ICs (docs/87); probe jobs only, no cost job yet

GcThreadCheck.how: thread compare in every GC_malloc; correctness probe, no cost job yet

IcLockCheck.how: counting loader lock (docs/29 §5); correctness probe, no cost job yet

LoadProf.how: world-load timers only; nothing per tick in play, load runs only

ProbeValues.how: counting stubs on many routing entries + 2 s poll thread (docs/108)

ProbeSnap.how: int3 snapshots, 16 hits per site per 30 s window (docs/94 §7, docs/109)

RouteSnap.audits.how: clone audits (AuditEvery / VerifyEvery / ReplayAudit*) compare whole snapshots
